sample_unit: patients (prospective stage; 60 patients in retrospective stage)

links.outcome: Clinician and external LLM quality ratings of generated reports on real patient data
links.effect: Total scores 18.15 (SD 1.36) clinicians vs 18.28 (SD 1.26) external LLM, P=.55; one hallucination event identified in 60 reports.
links.quote: Professional evaluation showed high overall quality scores from both clinicians and the external LLM, with no significant difference between evaluators (mean total scores 18.15, SD 1.36 vs 18.28, SD 1.26; P=.55).

unlisted_practices: Incorporating longitudinal comparison with prior examinations into LLM-generated patient-friendly reports
Using an external LLM as a judge alongside clinicians to rate report quality

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM-based system to generate patient-friendly echocardiography reports, testing it prospectively with real patients and family members to measure comprehension and anxiety reduction, but it does not compare outcomes with and without a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
